$schema_note: Reviewed aggregate evidence for three current-squad players who lack previous-Premier-League rate history. These values are research-only and do not alter production xPts.
source_attribution: Data from FBref.com, a Sports Reference site. Please cite and link FBref/Sports Reference when these aggregates are used.
aggregation_scope: 2025-26 domestic top-flight league matches only; cup, UEFA, international, and friendly matches excluded

evidence.minutes_note: The FBref competition summary reports 3068 minutes; summing the displayed integer match-log minutes gives 3072. The published competition-summary value is retained.

metric_note: Goals-per-90 and assists-per-90 are realised scoring rates, not expected-goals or expected-assists metrics. They are retained for audit context only.
modelling_decisions: Do not infer that Jacquet was injured solely from gaps in the match log.
